# NanoTab — pay for APIs with USDC on Base

NanoTab lets AI agents pay for APIs and content in one HTTP call.
Real USDC on Base mainnet. Fee: 0.1% (10 bps).

## Install

```bash
npm i @nanotab/agent-sdk
```

## Pay (3 lines)

```js
import { nanotabFetch } from '@nanotab/agent-sdk';
const data = await nanotabFetch('https://gateway.nanotab.dev/keyword/ai%20agents');
```

Set your wallet key once: `export NANOTAB_WALLET_KEY=0x…`

## How it works (x402 flow)

1. Agent GETs a paid URL → gateway replies `402 Payment Required` with price.
2. SDK signs a USDC payment intent (EIP-191) and retries with `X-Payment`.
3. Gateway verifies (amount ≥ price, merchant wallet, USDC-on-Base, signature) and proxies to origin.

## Gateway

- Live gateway: `https://gateway.nanotab.dev`
- Chain: Base mainnet (8453) · Asset: USDC `0x833589fcD6eDB6e08f4C7c32d4f71B54BdA4B4E5`

## Pricing

- NanoTab fee: **0.1% (10 bps)**, taken atomically in the payment.
- No ETH needed — Circle TokenPaymaster sponsors gas from your USDC.
- Minimum payment: 1¢.
